## 5. Missing Dependencies — Recommended Actions

Nothing below has been executed. Each requires your approval.

### 5.1 npm (REQUIRED)

**Option A — Debian package (recommended, needs sudo):**

```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y npm
```

Installs npm 12.2.0 from the Kali repository alongside the existing Node 24.

**Option B — Corepack, no root required:**

```bash
corepack enable npm
corepack install -g npm@latest
npm --version
```

Uses the already-installed Corepack to download npm into `~/.cache/node/corepack` and shim it. Requires network access to registry.npmjs.org. No system packages are touched.

Either option is acceptable. Option A is simplest; Option B avoids elevated permissions.

### 5.2 GitHub CLI (OPTIONAL — only for automating repo creation)

`gh` is not in Kali's repos. Official GitHub apt repository (needs sudo):

```bash
sudo mkdir -p -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings
wget -nv -O /tmp/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
sudo cp /tmp/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
sudo chmod go+r /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y gh
gh auth login
```

This adds a third-party apt source. **Alternative without installing anything:** create the repository through the GitHub web UI and push over HTTPS or SSH. Both paths will be documented in Phase 0F.

### 5.3 Git identity (REQUIRED before first commit — no sudo)

Replace the placeholders with your real details. These are **not** set automatically.

```bash
git config --global user.name  "<Your Name>"
git config --global user.email "<your-github-email>"
git config --global init.defaultBranch main
```

## 6. Risks and Observations

1. **OS mismatch** — Kali instead of Ubuntu. Low impact; noted so future documentation does not assume Ubuntu-only package availability.
2. **Disk at 78 %** — Adequate today. Playwright browsers add ~500 MB; monitor before Phase 1.
3. **No Git identity** — First commit is blocked until §5.3 is done.
4. **No npm** — Dependency installation (Phase 1) is blocked until §5.1 is done. Phase 0 (documentation, structure, Git init) does **not** require npm.
5. **No gh / no GitHub auth** — Repository creation must be done manually or after §5.2.
6. **Kali default tooling** — Kali ships many security tools; none interfere with a Node/Vite workflow.
